title: rust workspace must exclude oscore-fork from workspace discovery
description: Reviewer pass-1 finding (from xyt6.1): if rust/oscore-fork is a real directory (not a symlink), cargo workspace discovery from the fork's manifest walks up and finds rust/Cargo.toml; oscore-fork is in neither members nor exclude, risking 'current package believes it is in a workspace when it is not' errors or accidental membership. Fix: add exclude = ["oscore-fork"] to [workspace] in rust/Cargo.toml (harmless no-op for the symlink case since cargo canonicalizes outside the workspace).
close_reason: Re-close: shared-store rollback (5th incident) dropped the close. Work committed in ebdf8c0f04: exclude = ["oscore-fork"] added to [workspace] in rust/Cargo.toml; verified empirically both symlink and real-dir cases resolve.
